diameterBasis: Motor_Gmsh_Elmer_Design_Study.pdf p4: housing R48–56, OD112; p10: barrel OD112; appendix p39 confirms end-cap bounds ±56 mm. Nominal simulation/CAD candidate, not measured hardware.
centralOpeningNote: Proposed PCB aperture matches the motor shoulder opening Ø28 (study p10), clearing Ø12 shaft and Ø19 locknut. Encoder support and board axial mounting need CAD confirmation.

mounting.note: Study p10: six M4×30 per end, PCD104, cap clearance4.5. Appendix p39 bolt centers imply 30°+60°k. Head envelope Ø7. This transfers nominal CAD dimensions; PCB fastener lengths, load paths and standoffs remain to be selected.
mounting.edgeClearanceNote: Drill edge-to-board margin is 1.75 mm nominal (56-52-2.25). Library fastener keepout may extend past the PCB boundary; keepout is reserved on both faces. Nominal study head Ø7 fits inside housing OD with 0.5 mm radial margin.

installation: External rear annular PCB. All connectors and C1-C5 face outward. Proposed 7 mm cap-to-PCB gap: cap end z105, PCB motor-facing plane z112, outward plane z113.6, shaft end z120. Six replacement spacer/fastener concepts require structural and insulation review.
source: Motor_Gmsh_Elmer_Design_Study.pdf pp4,10,39; electrical baseline remains Space_Octopus_Motor_PCB_Plan_RevA.pdf.
placementPolicy: Face body courtyards plus opposite-face solder/lead projections. Connectors and tall capacitors outward; low-profile motor-facing devices; protected Kelvin pickup barrels. Original cap clamp hardware must be redesigned for PCB mounting.
centralOpeningKeepoutNote: Physical aperture is circular Ø28. Placement conservatively reserves its bounding square plus 1 mm edge gap to satisfy the current tscircuit hole overlap checker.
